results.title: Major Clubs Women’s 50-over tournament SSC, Panadura SC, Army and Air Force win in opening weekend
results.description: SSC, Panadura SC and the two forces teams Army SC and Air Force SC won their respective matches in the opening weekend of the Major Clubs Women’s 50-over tournament.

results.title: MMU Eighth In GPAC Volleyball Poll
results.description: SIOUX CITY, Iowa — A year after qualifying for the Great Plains Athletic Conference post-season tournament, the Mount Marty University volleyball team claimed the eighth spot in the GPAC preseason poll, announced Monday.

results.title: Palestinian football set to return after Israel's 3-year Gaza war halt
results.description: Palestinian football is set to resume in September after nearly three years of suspended activity amid Israel’s war on Gaza, the Palestinian Football Association announced Monday....
